"""Regenerate the exact recorded open-loop action tape for dispose_of_glass.

The tape was captured from primitive motions in the fixed instance and ended at the
BDDL success transition. It is embedded so regeneration never re-solves IK.
"""
import argparse
import base64
import zlib
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
from rcb_behavior import Session

def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument('--replay', action='store_true', help='self-check after writing')
    args = parser.parse_args()
    raw = zlib.decompress(base64.b85decode(_TAPE))
    actions = np.frombuffer(raw, dtype='<f4').reshape(-1, 25).copy()
    assert actions.shape == (5491, 25)
    out = Path('/app/output/trajectory.npz')
    out.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    session = Session('dispose_of_glass', instance='/app/instance.json')
    session.save_trajectory(actions, out, meta={'source': 'interactive primitive trajectory', 'success_steps': 5491})
    print(f'Wrote {len(actions)} actions to {out}')
    if args.replay:
        print(session.replay(actions))


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
